entries.question: BMLT me Admition मेरिट लिस्ट पर नहीं होता है अगर होता है तो कैसे बताइए
entries.answer:
KGMU mein BMLT (Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology) ya anya paramedical courses mein admission ki prakriya aamtaur par **Entrance Examination** ke madhyam se hoti hai, na ki sirf merit list par.

KGMU mein admission lene ka tarika is prakar hai:

1.  **Entrance Exam:** KGMU har saal paramedical aur nursing courses ke liye ek pravesh pariksha (Entrance Exam) aayojit karta hai. Aapko is exam mein shamil hona aur qualify karna hota hai.
2.  **Official Notification:** Admission se sambandhit sabhi jaankari, jaise ki exam ki date, syllabus, aur form bharne ki pratikriya, KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par "Courses & Admissions" section mein jari ki jati hai.
3.  **Counselling:** Entrance exam mein prapt kiye gaye marks ke aadhar par ek merit list taiyar ki jati hai, jiske baad counselling prakriya hoti hai. Counselling ke dauran hi aapko course aur college allot kiya jata hai.

**Sallaha:**
*   Aap samay-samay par KGMU ki website [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) ko check karte rahein taaki aapko latest admission notification mil sake.
*   Kisi bhi private agent ya galat jankari se bachein. KGMU mein admission hamesha official portal ke madhyam se hi hota hai.

Agar aapko 2026 ke admission ya kisi specific entrance exam ke bare mein janna hai, toh kripya website par notice board check karein.

entries.question: डीएल टीम में एडमिशन कब से चालू है और मेरे 80% हैं मेरिट में एडमिशन नहीं होगा हिंदी मेंबताइए
entries.answer:
KGMU mein BMLT (Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology) ya kisi bhi paramedical course mein admission **sirf 12th ki percentage (merit) ke aadhar par nahi hota hai.**

Yahan admission ki prakriya ko samajh lijiye:

1.  **Entrance Exam Zaroori Hai:** KGMU mein admission ke liye aapko university dwara aayojit **Entrance Examination** dena hota hai. Chahe aapke 80% marks hon ya 90%, aapko entrance exam mein qualify karna hi padega.
2.  **Merit List Kaise Banti Hai:** Entrance exam mein aap jo marks laate hain, uske aadhar par ek merit list taiyar hoti hai. Counselling ke samay usi merit list ke hisaab se seat allot ki jaati hai.
3.  **Admission Kab Shuru Hote Hain:** Admission ke form aamtaur par har saal (aane wale satra ke liye) apni nirdharit samay-sarni (Academic Calendar) ke anusar nikalte hain. Abhi 2026 ke liye koi naya notification nahi hai.
4.  **Aapko Kya Karna Chahiye:**
    *   Aap KGMU ki official website: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) par lagatar nazar rakhein.
    *   Jab entrance exam ka form nikle, tab aapko use online bharna hoga.
    *   Aapke 80% marks ka labh aapko entrance exam ki taiyari aur uske baad ki counseling mein mil sakta hai, lekin entrance exam dena anivarya (mandatory) hai.

**Kripya dhyan dein:** Kisi bhi aise vyakti ya website par vishwas na karein jo ye kahe ki aapka admission sirf 80% marks ke aadhar par bina entrance exam ke ho jayega. Ye galat ho sakta hai.

Main "KGMU AI CHATBOT" hoon, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav ne banaya hai. Main sirf aapko sahi raasta dikha sakta hoon. Admission ke liye hamesha official website ka hi prayog karein.

entries.question: How to complaint about fraud happening in kgmu
entries.answer:
If you suspect any fraudulent activity at King George's Medical University, you can report it through the following official channels:

1.  **RTI (Right to Information):** You can file an RTI request to seek transparency or report issues regarding administrative matters. Detailed information and the contact for the Public Information Officer (PIO) can be found here: [https://kgmu.org/rti.php](https://kgmu.org/rti.php)
2.  **Public Relations Office (PRO):** You may contact the PRO office for assistance or to escalate your concerns regarding patient care or administrative irregularities. Contact details for various PRO offices are available here: [https://kgmu.org/pro_cug.php](https://kgmu.org/pro_cug.php)
3.  **Anti-Ragging/Grievance Guidelines:** For general complaints or grievances, you can refer to the official guidelines provided by the university: [https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php](https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php)
4.  **Vigilance/Administration:** You may also reach out to the Registrar’s office or the Vice Chancellor’s office if the matter is of a serious administrative or financial nature.
    *   **VC Office:** 0522-2257540 / 0522-2258880 (Extn-3)
    *   **Registrar Office:** 0522-2253171

**Important Note:** If you are reporting a medical emergency or a serious patient-related issue, please contact the **Patient Welfare Office at the Trauma Centre** at **8887019133** or the **CMO/ADO** at **8004849905**.

*I am the KGMU AI Chatbot, created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.*

entries.question: How Can I book an appointment for paediatric orthopaedic?

    *   Select Hospital: King George's Medical University.
    *   Select "New Appointment" and choose the "Paediatric Orthopaedics" department.
*   **Mobile App:** You can also use the **ABHA / Health Care App** available on the KGMU Play Store by following the same registration flow.

**2. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format: **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**. You will receive a booking confirmation.

**3. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   You can visit the hospital in person. Please bring the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number.
*   Go to the registration counter, provide your details, receive an OTP, and pay the **₹50 fee** to receive your physical OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–1:00 PM and Sat 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).

entries.question: Opd appointment cardiologist kaise book kare
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Cardiology (LARI Cardiology) OPD appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tarikon ka istemal kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (Sabse behtar tarika):**
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   **Process:** Login/Register karein → State (Uttar Pradesh) chunein → Hospital (King Georges Medical University) select karein → 'New Appointment' par click karein → Department (Cardiology) aur date select karein → Patient ki details bharein aur ₹50 ka online bhugtan (payment) karein.
*   **Mobile App:** Aap 'ABHA' ya 'ORS' app ka bhi prayog kar sakte hain.

**2. SMS ke dwara:**
*   Aap **8887019134** par *"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"* likhkar SMS bhej sakte hain.

**3. Telephone/Helpline:**
*   Aap **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call karke jankari le sakte hain.

**4. Walk-in (On-site):**
*   Agar aap hospital aakar karwana chahte hain, toh subah jaldi aayein (OPD counter subah 9:00 baje khulta hai).
*   **Zaroori cheezein:** Patient ka **Aadhaar Card** aur **Active Mobile Number** saath rakhein (OTP verification ke liye).
*   **Fee:** OPD slip ka shulk ₹50 hai.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne sambandhit department ka valid referral letter zaroor saath layein.
*   **Samay:** OPD ka samay Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM) hai. Ravivar ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Pre-booking:** Severe wait times se bachne ke liye online pre-booking ki salah di jaati hai.

Agar aapko medical advice ya diagnosis chahiye, toh main iske liye qualified nahi hoon. Kripya KGMU OPD mein doctor se paramarsh lein. Suraksha ke liye chat mein apni niji swasthya jankari ya personal details share na karein.

entries.question: Ham doctor ko ek bar dikha chuke hain jismein maine pahle apartment Li thi ki aap fir se mujhe appointment leni padegi uski fees Deni padegi
entries.answer:
Haan, KGMU mein follow-up (dobara dikhane) ke liye bhi aapko **dobara appointment lene ki aur ₹50 ki fee dene ki avashyakta hoti hai.**

KGMU ki OPD mein har baar naya registration (Parchi) banwana anivarya (mandatory) hota hai, chahe aap purane mareez hi kyun na hon. Iske liye aapko wahi process follow karna hoga:

1.  **Online Appointment:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) ya ORS mobile app ke zariye dobara slot book karein aur ₹50 ka bhugtan karein.
2.  **Walk-in:** Agar aap direct hospital ja rahe hain, toh counter par apna purana OPD card (old card) dikhayen, lekin wahan bhi aapko naye visit ke liye ₹50 ki slip katwani hogi.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
*   **Purana Card:** Apne saath apna purana KGMU OPD card aur saari purani reports zaroor le kar jayen, taaki doctor ko aapka treatment history samajhne mein aasani ho.
*   **Referral:** Agar aapne pehle referral ke sath dikhaya tha, toh check kar lein ki aapka referral abhi bhi valid hai ya nahi.

Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical advice ya treatment ke baare mein faisle nahi le sakta. Kripya apne doctor se hi aage ki jaanch ya follow-up ke baare mein baat karein. Suraksha ke liye chat mein apni niji medical jankari share na karein.
